references.text: Also deals with skin lesions (נֶגַע) on the body of a man or woman, part of the same legal collection concerning leprosy and skin diseases
Continues with regulations about disease in the head (רֹאשׁ), especially related to hair loss and leprosy in the head region
Describes the cleansing ritual for someone who has been affected by a skin disease (נֶגַע), following up on the diagnosis in chapter 13
Refers to leprosy (נֶגַע) and reminds one to follow the priests' instructions carefully
The introduction to the laws concerning skin lesions (נֶגַע) that are presented to the priest for examination
